scripts.text:
[Sponiac]
Why are you carrying so many items?
Are you in a training course or something?
scripts.translation:
[斯波尼亞克]
你為什麼攜帶這麼多物品？
你是在參加什麼訓練課程嗎？

scripts.text:
[Sponiac]
Lu~lu~lu~lu~
Lu~ Huh?
scripts.translation:
[斯波尼亞克]
盧~盧~盧~盧~
盧~ 嗯？

scripts.text:
[Sponiac]
Wow, you must be a beginner, right?
What an innocent face! Ha~ hahaha.
scripts.translation:
[斯波尼亞克]
哇，你一定是個新手吧？
多麼天真的臉啊！哈~ 哈哈哈。

scripts.text:
[Sponiac]
Why don't you do some hunting outside instead of walking around and wasting your time?
scripts.translation:
[斯波尼亞克]
與其四處閒逛浪費時間，不如去外面打獵呢。

scripts.text: I am about to leave now.
scripts.translation: 我正要離開。

scripts.text: I've got a Hunting Mission.
scripts.translation: 我有一個打獵任務。

scripts.text:
[Sponiac]
Oh, well. Then, go figure.
Bye~ bye.
scripts.translation:
[斯波尼亞克]
哦，好吧。那就隨你吧。
再見~

scripts.text:
[Sponiac]
Oh, you are from the Eden Group?
What mission do you have?
scripts.translation:
[斯波尼亞克]
哦，你是樂園團的？
你有什麼任務？

scripts.text: Hunting Poison Spore
scripts.translation: 狩獵毒魔菇

scripts.text: Hunting Smokie

scripts.text: Hunting Elder Willow

scripts.text: Hunting Coco

scripts.text: Hunting Thara Frog

scripts.text:
[Sponiac]
{0}!
Wow, I didn't expect you would do that mission. I was just about to give up. But you did good job. I appreciate it!
scripts.translation:
[斯波尼亞克]
{0}！
哇，沒想到你會做那個任務。我本來都要放棄了。但你做得很好，非常感謝！

scripts.text:
[Sponiac]
Well, I requested the mission and you did an excellent job.
I will give you a reward as I promised.
scripts.translation:
[斯波尼亞克]
嗯，我釋出了任務，而你出色地完成了它。
我會兌現承諾，給你獎勵。

scripts.text:
[Sponiac]
Here it is. Thank you very much. God bless you!
scripts.translation:
[斯波尼亞克]
給你。非常感謝。願上帝保佑你！

scripts.text:
[Sponiac]
Oh, you are right.
scripts.translation:
[斯波尼亞克]
哦，你說得對。

scripts.text:
[Sponiac]
But, you haven't done the mission yet. Why did you come to me now? You haven't completed the mission!
I will give you a reward if you complete the mission. Ok? Are we good?
scripts.translation:
[斯波尼亞克]
但是，你還沒有完成任務。為什麼現在來找我？你還沒完成呢！
等你完成任務後，我會給你獎勵的。好嗎？我們說定了？

scripts.text:
[Sponiac]
Anyway, I will be here waiting for you. Please come back when you finish the mission!
scripts.translation:
[斯波尼亞克]
總之，我會在這裡等你。完成任務後請回來找我！

scripts.text:
[Sponiac]
Huh? Are you sure? Something is wrong...
scripts.translation:
[斯波尼亞克]
咦？你確定嗎？哪裡不對勁...

scripts.text:
[Sponiac]
It is weird.
Please check your Quest Window by pressing 'alt + u'.
scripts.translation:
[斯波尼亞克]
這很奇怪。
請按 'alt + u' 鍵檢查你的任務視窗。

scripts.text:
[Dieshin Man]
Why are you carrying so many items?
Are you in a training course or something?
scripts.translation:
[迪辛的男子]
你為什麼帶著這麼多物品？
你是在參加什麼訓練課程嗎？

scripts.text:
[Dieshin Man]
Hu hu~~ we are delivery men~
We are faster than any flight~!
scripts.translation:
[迪辛的男子]
呼呼~~ 我們是快遞員~
我們比任何飛行都更快~！

scripts.text:
[Dieshin Man]
Welcome~ welcome!
We are the fastest delivery company, Dieshin Corperation.
scripts.translation:
[迪辛的男子]
歡迎~ 歡迎！
我們是速度最快的快遞公司，迪辛公司。

scripts.text:
[Dieshin Man]
How can I help you?
scripts.translation:
[迪辛的男子]
有什麼可以幫你的嗎？

scripts.text: I don't need help.
scripts.translation: 我不需要幫助。

scripts.text: I've got a Delivery Mission.
scripts.translation: 我有一個送貨任務。

scripts.text:
[Dieshin Man]
Oh, well. Then, go figure. Bye~!
scripts.translation:
[迪辛的男子]
哦，好吧。那就隨你吧。再見~！

scripts.text:
[Dieshin Man]
Oh, you are from the Eden Group?
What mission do you have?
scripts.translation:
[迪辛的男子]
哦，你是樂園團的嗎？
有什麼任務需要處理？

scripts.text: Deliver an Insecticide.
scripts.translation: 送殺蟲劑

scripts.text: Deliver Honey.
scripts.translation: 送蜂蜜

scripts.text: Deliver Blankets.
scripts.translation: 送毯子

scripts.text:
[Dieshin Man]
Huh? Are you sure? Something is wrong...
scripts.translation:
[迪辛的男子]
咦？你確定嗎？好像有點不對勁...

scripts.text:
[Dieshin Man]
It is weird.
Please check your Quest Window by pressing 'alt + u'.
scripts.translation:
[迪辛的男子]
這很奇怪。
請按 'alt + u' 檢查你的任務視窗。

scripts.text:
[Dieshin Man]
Wait, but you already have a delivery box.
scripts.translation:
[迪辛的男子]
等等，你手裡已經有一個送貨的木箱子了。

scripts.text:
[Dieshin Man]
We can't allow you to deliver two boxes at once. So, please finish your delivery first.
scripts.translation:
[迪辛的男子]
我們不能讓你一次送兩個箱子。所以，請先完成你當前的送貨任務。

scripts.text:
[Dieshin Man]
If you forgot where to deliver, then please check Quest Window by pressing 'alt + u'.
scripts.translation:
[迪辛的男子]
如果你忘了送到哪裡，請按 'alt + u' 檢查任務視窗。

scripts.text:
[Dieshin Man]
Ah ha! I got it!
The insecticide? It must be the Zoologist on the southeast of Payon who ordered the Insecticide.
scripts.translation:
[迪辛的男子]
啊哈！我想起來了！
殺蟲劑？應該是斐揚東南方的動物學家訂購的殺蟲劑。

scripts.text:
[Dieshin Man]
Ah ha! I got it!
Honey? It must be the Entomologist at the west of St. Capitolina Abbey, wich is northeast of Prontera who ordered the Honey.
scripts.translation:
[迪辛的男子]
啊哈！我想起來了！
蜂蜜？應該是普隆德拉東北方聖卡普蒂娜修道院西邊的昆蟲學家訂購的蜂蜜。

scripts.text:
[Dieshin Man]
Oh, Right!
The blankets! It must be the biologist in the south of Lutie field who ordered the blankets.
scripts.translation:
[迪辛的男子]
哦，對了！
毯子！應該是薑餅城野外南方的生物學家訂購的毯子。

scripts.text:
[Dieshin Man]
You can can go to Lutie by asking Mr. Claus in the northeastern part of Al De Baran.
scripts.translation:
[迪辛的男子]
你可以去找艾爾帕蘭東北方的克勞斯先生，讓他帶你去薑餅城。

scripts.text:
[Dieshin Man]
Dieshin's cooperation motive is to give the fastest and credited delivery. So please deliver it now without any delay.
scripts.translation:
[迪辛的男子]
迪辛公司的宗旨是提供最快速、最可靠的配送服務。所以請立刻送貨，不要延誤。

scripts.text:
[Dieshin Man]
If you forgot where to make the delivery, then please check the Quest Window by pressing 'alt + u'.
scripts.translation:
[迪辛的男子]
如果你忘了送到哪裡，請按 'alt + u' 檢查任務視窗。

scripts.text:
[Zoologist]
Why are you carrying so many items?
Are you in a training course or something?
scripts.translation:
[動物學家]
你為什麼帶著這麼多東西？
是在參加什麼訓練課程嗎？

scripts.text:
[Zoologist]
Have you heard of a monster named Bigfoot?
It looks like a bear with red fur and has a 'X' shape scar on his shoulder.
scripts.translation:
[動物學家]
你聽說過叫做大腳怪的魔物嗎？
它看起來像一頭紅毛熊，肩膀上有一個“X”形的傷疤。

scripts.text:
[Zoologist]
According to the recent research, flies and Bigfoot monsters have a symbiotic relationship.
scripts.translation:
[動物學家]
根據最近的研究，蒼蠅和大腳怪之間存在共生關係。

scripts.text:
[Zoologist]
I am currently studying about it and try to prove the theory. So I plan to kill the flies around Bigfoot and observe his reaction.
scripts.translation:
[動物學家]
我正在研究這個，並試圖證明這個理論。所以我打算殺死大腳怪周圍的蒼蠅，觀察它的反應。

scripts.text: ...I am not interested.
scripts.translation: ...我不感興趣。

scripts.text: Here is the Insecticide.
scripts.translation: 這是殺蟲劑。

scripts.text:
[Zoologist]
Oh, I need an Insecticide to continue the study.
scripts.translation:
[動物學家]
哦，我需要殺蟲劑才能繼續研究。

scripts.text:
[Zoologist]
Huh?
You are not Dieshin's delivery man?
scripts.translation:
[動物學家]
咦？
你不是迪辛的送貨員嗎？

scripts.text:
[Zoologist]
I am waiting for a special delivery.
scripts.translation:
[動物學家]
我在等一個特別的快遞。

scripts.text:
[Zoologist]
Oh ho! Yes! That one!
scripts.translation:
[動物學家]
哦！對對對！就是這個！

scripts.text:
[Zoologist]
That is the Insecticide that I ordered! You were sent by Dieshin right?
scripts.translation:
[動物學家]
這就是我訂購的殺蟲劑！你是迪辛派來的吧？

scripts.text:
[Zoologist]
I have been waiting for this!
Give it to me!
scripts.translation:
[動物學家]
我等了很久了！
快給我！

scripts.text:
[Zoologist]
It arrived much faster than I thought. I want to test it right away!
scripts.translation:
[動物學家]
比我想的快多了。我想馬上測試一下！

scripts.text:
[Zoologist]
Well done. Good Job! Thank you so much! Here is a little gift for you.
scripts.translation:
[動物學家]
幹得好。謝謝你的幫助！這是給你的小禮物。

scripts.text:
[Zoologist]
I appreciate your kindness.
But, what did you bring?
scripts.translation:
[動物學家]
謝謝你的好意。
不過，你帶了什麼來？

scripts.text:
[Zoologist]
Hmm, I thought that Dieshin was fast and accurate, but you brought me an empty box. How disappointing.
scripts.translation:
[動物學家]
嗯，我以為迪辛又快又準，結果你給我帶了個空盒子。真讓人失望。

scripts.text:
[Zoologist]
Please bring my order. Dieshin will give you my product.
scripts.translation:
[動物學家]
請把我的訂單帶來。迪辛會給你我的產品。

scripts.text:
[Entomologist]
Why are you carrying so many items?
Are you in a training course or something?
scripts.translation:
[昆蟲學家]
你為什麼帶著這麼多東西？
是在參加什麼訓練課程嗎？

scripts.text:
[Entomologist]
Have you heard about the Horn monster?
It's shaped like an insect with black sleek skin and it has a giant horn it's head.
scripts.translation:
[昆蟲學家]
你聽說過鍬形蟲這種魔物嗎？
它長得像昆蟲，皮膚黑亮，頭上有一根巨大的角。

scripts.text:
[Entomologist]
Recent research came out and showed that this monster can be tamed and trained by Honey.
scripts.translation:
[昆蟲學家]
最近的研究表明，這種魔物可以用蜂蜜馴服和訓練。

scripts.text:
[Entomologist]
I am currently studying about it and trying to prove the theory. So I plan to set a Honey trap on the places he usually passes and observe his reaction.
scripts.translation:
[昆蟲學家]
我正在研究這個，並試圖證明這個理論。所以我打算在它經常經過的地方設定蜂蜜陷阱，觀察它的反應。

scripts.text: ...I am not interested.
scripts.translation: ...我不感興趣。

scripts.text: Here is the Honey.
scripts.translation: 這是蜂蜜。

scripts.text:
[Entomologist]
Oh, I need Honey to continue the study.
scripts.translation:
[昆蟲學家]
哦，我需要蜂蜜才能繼續研究。

Huh?
You are not Dieshin's delivery man?
scripts.translation:

I am waiting for a special delivery.

scripts.text:

Oh ho! Yes! That one!
scripts.translation:

哦！是的！就是這個！

scripts.text:

That is the Honey that I ordered! You were sent by Dieshin right?
scripts.translation:

scripts.text:

I have been waiting for this!

scripts.translation:

快給我！

scripts.text:

scripts.translation:

謝謝你的好意。

scripts.text:

scripts.translation:

嗯，我以為迪辛又快又準，結果你給我帶了個空盒子。真讓人失望。

scripts.translation:
[昆蟲學家]
請把我的訂單帶來。迪辛會給你我的產品。

scripts.text:
[Biologist]
Why are you carrying so many items?
Are you in a training course or something?
scripts.translation:
[生物學家]
你身上怎麼帶了這麼多東西？
是在參加什麼訓練課程嗎？

scripts.text:
[Biologist]
Have you heard about the Marin monster?
It does look like the usual poring, but it has unique characteristic.
scripts.translation:
[生物學家]
你聽說過冰波利這種魔物嗎？
它看起來像普通的波利，但有著獨特的特性。

scripts.text:
[Biologist]
Porings steal items if they see them on the ground. However, Marin has no interest in dropped items. So I was wondering, how come Marin doesn't pay attention to gathering items even though they are the same kind of monster as Porings.
scripts.translation:
[生物學家]
波利看到地上的物品會偷走它們。然而，冰波利對掉落物品毫無興趣。所以我很想知道，既然冰波利和波利是同一種類的魔物，為什麼冰波利不關注收集物品呢。

scripts.text:
[Biologist]
But, this place is freaking cold.
scripts.translation:
[生物學家]
但是，這裡冷得要命。

scripts.text: ...I am not interested.
scripts.translation: ...我不感興趣。

scripts.text: Here are the blankets.
scripts.translation: 這是毯子。

scripts.text:
[Biologist]
Huh, whatever. But be careful! It's very slippery here.
scripts.translation:

哼，隨便吧。但小心點！這裡很滑。

It arrived much faster than I thought. I want to test them right away!
scripts.translation:
[生物學家]
比我想的快多了。我想馬上測試一下！

scripts.text:
[Biologist]
Well done. Good Job! Thank you so much! Here is a little gift for you.
scripts.translation:
[生物學家]
做得好。幹得漂亮！非常感謝！這是給你的小禮物。

scripts.text:
[Biologist]
I appreciate your kindness.
But, what did you bring?
scripts.translation:
[生物學家]
我很感激你的好意。
但是，你帶來了什麼？

scripts.text:
[Biologist]
Hmm, I thought that Dieshin was fast and accurate, but you brought me an empty box. How disappointing.
scripts.translation:
[生物學家]
嗯，我以為迪辛既快又準，結果你給我帶了個空盒子。真讓人失望。

scripts.text:
[Biologist]
Please bring my order. Dieshin will give you my product.
scripts.translation:
[生物學家]
請把我的訂單帶過來。迪辛會把我的產品交給你。

scripts.text:
[Dashia]
Why are you carrying so many items?
Are you in a training course or something?
scripts.translation:
[達西亞]
你為什麼帶著這麼多東西？
是在參加什麼訓練課程嗎？

scripts.text:
[Dashia]
Here is some hair~ a broken clock~!
scripts.translation:
[達西亞]
這裡有一些頭髮~ 還有一個壞掉的鐘~！

scripts.text:
[Dashia]
Broken clock..? Hu hu..
scripts.translation:
[達西亞]
壞掉的鐘..？呼呼..

scripts.text:
[Dashia]
Hey~! Dude! You look like a very rich adventurer.
scripts.translation:
[達西亞]
嘿~！夥計！你看起來像個很有錢的冒險者。

scripts.text: I am a poor adventurer.
scripts.translation: 我是個貧窮的冒險者。

scripts.text: I have a gathering mission.
scripts.translation: 我有一個採集任務。

scripts.text:
[Dashia]
Really? Hmm, oh right. You don't look sophisticated.
scripts.translation:
[達西亞]
真的嗎？嗯，對了。你看起來並不富裕。

scripts.text:
[Dashia]
You are a poor adventurer~! Good luck!
scripts.translation:
[達西亞]
你是個貧窮的冒險者~！祝你好運！

scripts.text:
[Dashia]
Oh, you are from the Eden Group?
What mission do you have?
scripts.translation:
[達西亞]
哦，你是樂園團的？
你有什麼任務？

scripts.text: Gather Bones
scripts.translation: 採集骨頭

scripts.text: Gather Animal Skin
scripts.translation: 採集動物外皮

scripts.text: Gather Peelings
scripts.translation: 採集果皮

scripts.text: Gather Tails
scripts.translation: 採集尾巴

scripts.text: Gather Cookies
scripts.translation: 採集綠餅人

scripts.text: Gather Mustaches
scripts.translation: 採集鬍子

scripts.text:
[Dashia]
I can see that you have a gathering mission.
But, where are the Skel-Bones?
scripts.translation:
[達西亞]
我看你有采集任務。
但是，骷髏骨在哪裡？

scripts.text:
[Dashia]
You haven't done the mission yet. Why did you come back here?
scripts.translation:
[達西亞]
你還沒做任務呢。為什麼又回到這裡？

scripts.text:
[Dashia]
You don't have enough 'Skel-Bones'... You can find it when you hunt Skeletons.
scripts.translation:
[達西亞]
你的“骷髏骨”不夠... 打邪骸戰士可以掉落。

scripts.text:
[Dashia]
To find Skeletons, you better check Payon Dungeon 1F, which is located in Archer Village, north of Payon.
scripts.translation:
[達西亞]
想要找邪骸戰士，建議去斐揚北邊的弓箭手村，那裡有一樓斐揚地下城。

scripts.text:
[Dashia]
I can see that you have a gathering mission.
But, where is the Bear's Footskins and Animal Skins?
scripts.translation:
[達西亞]
我看你有采集任務。
但是，熊掌和動物外皮在哪裡？

scripts.text:
[Dashia]
You haven't done the mission yet. Why did you come back here?
scripts.translation:
[達西亞]
你還沒做任務呢。為什麼又回到這裡？

scripts.text:
[Dashia]
You have to bring 10 Bear's Footskins' and '5 Animal Skins!
You can find Bear's Footskin from Bigfoot and Animal Skin from Animals.
scripts.translation:
[達西亞]
你需要帶10個熊掌和5個動物外皮來完成這個任務。
大腳怪會掉落熊掌，動物會掉落動物外皮。

scripts.text:
[Dashia]
Bigfoot is around the north of Geffen field or the southeast of Payon field.
scripts.translation:
[達西亞]
大腳怪在吉芬野外北部或斐揚野外東南部附近。

scripts.text:
[Dashia]
I can see that you have a gathering mission.
But, where are the Worm Peelings and Garlets?
scripts.translation:
[達西亞]
我看你有采集任務。
但是，蟲皮和加勒結晶在哪裡？

scripts.text:
[Dashia]
You have to bring '20 Worm Peelings' and '20 Garlets' to complete the mission.
scripts.translation:
[達西亞]
你需要帶20個蟲皮和20個加勒結晶來完成這個任務。

scripts.text:
[Dashia]
You can get those items from 'Piere', 'Andre', 'Deniro', 'Vitata', 'Thief Bug', 'Female Thief Bug' and 'Male Thief Bug'.
scripts.translation:
[達西亞]
你可以從工蟻、白蟻、兵蟻、黑蟻、浮勒盜蟲、雌性浮勒盜蟲和雄性浮勒盜蟲身上獲得這些物品。

scripts.text:
[Dashia]
'Piere', 'Andre', 'Deniro' and 'Vitata' are in Ant Hell which is located near the Saint Darmain Fortress soutwest of Morocc.
scripts.translation:
[達西亞]
工蟻、白蟻、兵蟻和黑蟻在螞蟻地獄，位於摩洛克西南方的聖達姆安要塞附近。

scripts.text:
[Dashia]
'Thief Bug', 'Female Thief Bug' and 'Male Thief Bug' are int he Prontere Culvert. To get there, you need to be a volunteer of the Prontera Culvert's punitive force.
scripts.translation:
[達西亞]
浮勒盜蟲、雌性浮勒盜蟲和雄性浮勒盜蟲在普隆德拉下水道。要到達那裡，你需要成為普隆德拉下水道懲罰部隊的志願者。

scripts.text:
[Dashia]
I can see that you have a gathering mission.
But, where are the Yoyo Tails, Acorns and Raccoon Leafs?
scripts.translation:
[達西亞]
我看你有采集任務。
但是，溜溜猴尾巴、橡果和變身葉子在哪裡？

scripts.text:
[Dashia]
You haven't done the mission yet. Why did you come back here?
You have to bring '10 Yoyo Tails,' '10 Acorns' and '10 Raccoon Leafs' to complete the mission.
scripts.translation:
[達西亞]
你還沒做任務呢。為什麼又回到這裡？
你需要帶10個溜溜猴尾巴、10個橡果和10個變身葉子來完成這個任務。

scripts.text:
[Dashia]
You can get Yoyo Tails from 'Yoyo's', Acorn from 'Coco's' and Raccoon Leaf from 'Smokies'.
scripts.translation:
[達西亞]
溜溜猴尾巴可以從溜溜猴身上獲得，橡果可以從可可身上獲得，變身葉子可以從狸貓身上獲得。

scripts.text:
[Dashia]
You can find them easily around fields, but the field east of Ayothaya is the best spot for hunting all 3 monsters.
scripts.translation:
[達西亞]
在野外很容易找到它們，但哎喲泰雅東邊的野外是打這三種魔物最好的地方。

scripts.text:
[Dashia]
To get to Ayothaya, you better go to 'Aibakthing' in Alberta and pay his fare.
scripts.translation:
[達西亞]
要去哎喲泰雅，最好去艾爾貝塔找艾巴克辛並支付車費。

scripts.text:
[Dashia]
I can see that you have a gathering mission.
But, where are the Well-baked Cookies and the Piece of Cake?
scripts.translation:
[達西亞]
我看你有采集任務。
但是，薑餅和小蛋糕在哪裡？

scripts.text:
[Dashia]
You haven't done the mission yet. Why did you come back here?
You have to bring '5 Well-baked Cookies' and '1 Piece of Cake' to complete the mission.
scripts.translation:
[達西亞]
你還沒做任務呢。為什麼又回到這裡？
你需要帶5個薑餅和1個小蛋糕來完成這個任務。

scripts.text:
[Dashia]
You can get Well-baked Cookie from 'Cookies' who wears red or green shirts.
For getting Piece of Cake, you should look for 'Mystcases'.
scripts.translation:
[達西亞]
薑餅可以從穿紅衣服或綠衣服的綠餅人身上獲得。
要獲得小蛋糕，你應該去找神秘箱。

scripts.text:
[Dashia]
Both monsters canbe found in the Toy Factory Warehouse or Toy Monitoring Room. To get there, ask Mr. Claus in the northeastern part of Al De Baran.
scripts.translation:
[達西亞]
這兩種魔物都可以在玩具工廠倉庫或玩具分類場找到。要到達那裡，請去艾爾帕蘭東北部的克勞斯先生那裡詢問。

scripts.text:
[Dashia]
I can see that you have a gathering mission.
But, where are the Mole Whiskerss and Mole Claws??
scripts.translation:
[達西亞]
我看你有采集任務。
但是，鼠須和鼠指甲在哪裡？

scripts.text:
[Dashia]
You haven't done the mission yet. Why did you come back here?
You have to bring '5 Mole Whiskers' and '3 Mole Claws' to complete the mission.
scripts.translation:
[達西亞]
你還沒做任務呢。為什麼又回到這裡？
你需要帶5個鼠須和3個鼠指甲來完成這個任務。

scripts.text:
[Dashia]
You can get those items from 'Martins'.
Martins can be found in the Mjolnir Dead Pit, but the second floor is dangerous, so be careful!
scripts.translation:
[達西亞]
你可以從土撥鼠身上獲得這些物品。
土撥鼠可以在妙勒尼爾死亡之坑找到，但第二層很危險，請小心！

scripts.text:
[Dashia]
To get there, ask a Kafra Employee in Geffen, they can warp you there.
scripts.translation:
[達西亞]
要到達那裡，請去吉芬找卡普拉 職員，他們可以傳送你過去。

scripts.text:
[Dashia]
Anyway, I will be here waiting for you. Please come back when you finish the mission!
scripts.translation:
[達西亞]
總之，我會在這裡等你。完成任務後請回來找我！

scripts.text:
[Dashia]
Huh? Are you sure? Something is wrong...
scripts.translation:
[達西亞]
咦？你確定嗎？好像哪裡不對勁...

scripts.text:
[Dashia]
It is weird.
Please check your Quest Window by pressing 'alt + u'.
scripts.translation:
[達西亞]
這很奇怪。
請按'alt + u'檢查你的任務視窗。

scripts.text:
[Dashia]
Wow~ you did an excellent job!
scripts.translation:
[達西亞]
哇~ 你做得太棒了！

scripts.text:
[Dashia]
Thank you very much. God bless you!
scripts.translation:
[達西亞]
非常感謝。願上帝保佑你！

scripts.text:
[Dashia]
Ha~! Ha~!
I will give you a reward as promised.
scripts.translation:
[達西亞]
哈~！哈~！
我會按承諾給你獎勵。
